cd packages/*.reason: Run package-scoped work from the repo root: `pnpm --filter @gotgenes/<pkg> run|exec …` or `pnpm -C packages/<pkg> …`, and root-relative paths (`packages/<pkg>/src/…`) for grep, sed, and read. A package-directory cwd breaks fallow's root-relative zones and mixes up relative paths

rg -r*.reason: `-r` is `--replace`, not `--recursive`: it rewrites every match and drops the line numbers. `rg` recurses by default, so drop the `-r`. If you do mean a replacement, spell it `--replace` — this rule does not match that

git commit*-F.reason: This is `git commit -F -` with a heredoc body, which trips an approval prompt the operator must clear by hand. Write the message to a file with the `Write` tool, then `git commit -F <file>` — this rule does not match that spelling

git commit*-F-.reason: This is `git commit -F-` with a heredoc body, which trips an approval prompt the operator must clear by hand. Write the message to a file with the `Write` tool, then `git commit -F <file>` — this rule does not match that spelling

git commit*-F /dev/stdin*.reason: This is `git commit -F /dev/stdin` with a heredoc body, which trips two approval prompts the operator must clear by hand. Write the message to a file with the `Write` tool, then `git commit -F <file>` — this rule does not match that spelling
